angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 278,280 km at 180.11 pc = 0.02 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.5520 +/- 0.0630 mas (same row, RUWE 0.99): 180.11 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.4 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Castro-González et al. 2022, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-95 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022MNRAS.509.1075C/abstract): 278,280 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.41 +/- 0.01 solar masses from Castro-González et al. 2022, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-95 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022MNRAS.509.1075C/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3566 +/- 34 K from Castro-González et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-95 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022MNRAS.509.1075C/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Castro-González et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-95 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022MNRAS.509.1075C/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/k2-95.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.847, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-95 (pscomppars): spectral type M3.0, from Obermeier et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016AJ....152..223O/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-95 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.1 dex, from Castro-González et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022MNRAS.509.1075C/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-95 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.63451, from Mann et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153...64M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-95 (pscomppars): age 0.79 Gyr, from Mann et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153...64M/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-95 (pscomppars): rotation period 23.9 d, from Mann et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153...64M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-95 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.6 km/s, from Mann et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153...64M/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
